And we had rough agreement of client teams either on one of the calls or in discord, or even both venues Heya, My Kiln Geth got stuck somehow yesterday morning... It's repeating the following lines in a loop in the logs: https://pastebin.com/RzJq3G3h Anything I should capture before restarting geth? It's a bad block! It may be interesting to take a look into, I'd advise you to keep it running until geth team reaches you out. What CL client are you running? cc <@360491619402776577> lighthouse I'll keep it running 🙂 Just analyzed the logs.. It first happened yesterday at 07:00:01 in the morning. But nothing more in the log around this time So, it got stuck to this block and isn't trying to move forward, right? yes, I don't see anything higher than number=402,572 in the logs. If you can tell me the api endpoint to get the chain head i can validate via the geth api, too 😉 You may use `GET /eth/v1/beacon/headers/head` to query your beacon node for the head Giving me this: ```{ "data": { "root": "0xd3d3272df0a854c8b3f397508b490a0b275db5dd0789c133cf7597885b7b22aa", "canonical": true, "header": { "message": { "slot": "402358", "proposer_index": "107010", "parent_root": "0x6d7a7915b0459f0edc586b15003dc4cd9efb0d2a56bd8257ffb2d814d629a441", "state_root": "0x641d3dab0f18f4a2fa5ef783904ce317b09a3056cdc2951f5b9438ab388e82f6", "body_root": "0xc75343414e8578bb99e8a160cc861335475127d95fa8e0a344ddeafa63305f6d" }, "signature": "0x88ea6d9469e91022c306f43fb1ecc2ea71b0d5c83d31dd8e9389f7cd85ebac53a0f3e75a220be1b2c461166b83df9d6f09a167dac50b60c22a26ea3c62c1def61bb76d3cf284d243d7a8aac3ab91ac1e0d8bb4f3b9190c5c7da9e0b9a5fa5903" } } }``` Could be that it's not the newest version of geth / lighthouse.. I didn't keep it up to date in the last weeks 😅 go-ethereum (ref: refs/heads/merge-kiln-v2): 3abd590144392160264cce0c0f095c53cc1d5520 (built: 15.03.2022) lighthouse: (ref: refs/heads/kiln): 972354a1788bb1d8a038d7647f44b72a2a36cc22 (built: 13.03.2022) I don't know if there was anything critical released in meantime... Maybe thats the reason for it... Thanks for the info, let's wait for developers to chime in proposer_index is pointing to one of my own validators there, but according to the beaconchain explorer the proposer for slot 402358 was 77400 🤔 Hmm, seems like something went wrong earlier. I found some more BAD BLOCKS at 06:53:36 on slot 401043 / block 402572.. After that it looks like it was following another chain till it got stuck 7 minutes later (when it was trying to propose a block) I've collected all logs during this time: https://pastebin.com/x3VmD4AE (it's unfortunately quite much as there are 1024 validators running :D) <@808969530608451584> Could you do a `debug_standardTraceBadBlockToFile`of the bad blocks? yea, if you tell me how? 😄 debug namespace is enabled via http api <#910910348922589184> <@808969530608451584> ``` curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"debug_standardTraceBadBlockToFile","params":["0xBlockhash"],"id":67}' http://localhost:8545 ``` Just replace 0xBlockhash with the block you want to trace Ah wait, the bad block only has one transfer in it, so tracing it doesn't really matter just giving me: {"output":"","gasUsed":"0x0","time":1944} in the file yeah, not really interesting 😄 No gas used inside the EVM is that line related to it? ``WARN [05-06|06:53:36.109] Failed to load old bad blocks error="leveldb: not found"`` it was printed just before the first bad block.. No, that is only because we have never stored a bad block before (and expected) Can you leave the node running until monday? I will take a look at this then Yea, sure 👍 <#910910348922589184> Hmm, I started a backup bn on another machine to get the validators up again while primary bn is stuck... Works fine for I'd say 99.9% of the attestations/sync committee contributions, but I'm regularly reading this message from the validators: ```ERRO Unable to publish signed contributions and proofs, error: All endpoints failed http://localhost:5052/ => Unavailable(NotSynced), http://10.16.97.2:5052/ => RequestFailed(ServerIndexedMessage(IndexedErrorMessage { code: 400, message: "BAD_REQUEST: error processing contribution and proofs", failures: [Failure { index: 0, message: "Verification: AggregatorNotInCommittee { aggregator_index: 107049 }" }] })), http://localhost:5052/ => RequestFailed(ServerMessage(ErrorMessage { code: 503, message: "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: beacon node is syncing: head slot is 402358, current slot is 411707", stacktraces: [] })), slot: 411707, service: sync_committee``` What is that AggregatorNotInCommittee error about? Maybe a timing issue due to latency? (backup bn is on an external machine) Time is in sync on both machines... If you shut the node down, you can do a 'geth snapshot verify-state'. It might help pinpoint the problem Primary Geth & Lighthouse BN are still up and in this stuck state. I'll keep them up for <@360491619402776577> Running the validator client with the external bn only (without the stuck one) made the error disappear... Maybe lighthouse still polled some information from the out of sync bn before 🤔
